title: The discrete quantum group $su_q(2)$ and its dual
summary: Discrete quantum groups were introduced as duals of compact quantum groups by Podleś and Woronowicz in 1990. They have been studied intrinsically by Effros and Ruan (1994) and by the author (1996). In a more recent note (2025), we have given a slightly updated treatment, viewing the duality between discrete and compact quantum groups as a special case of the more general duality of algebraic quantum groups. Along these lines, we start in this paper with the discrete quantum group $su_q(2)$, not constructed as the dual of the compact quantum group $SU_q(2)$ but rather from the Hopf algebra…
